name: Western
description: Conventions typical of Western-oriented web UX: lower density, more whitespace, clear single focal path, search-led entry. Tendencies, not rules.

name: China
description: Conventions typical of mainland-China-oriented web UX: higher density, image-led cards, parallel entry points, discovery feeds. Tendencies, not rules.

name: Hybrid
description: Explicit, user-defined composition of rules from other profiles. Preliminary.
